gap_statement: Cross-study comparability may be a field-level problem because reviews repeatedly partition evidence by task, domain, device, or evaluation perspective rather than providing a shared comparability model.
evidence_basis: General, user-study, industrial, visualization, wearable and SLAM reviews show specialized evidence structures.
verification_needed: Primary-study sampling plus explicit test of metric/protocol compatibility.

gap_statement: Reproducibility should be analyzed separately from review transparency: an open review dataset does not imply that the primary AR algorithms/results are reproducible.
evidence_basis: Recent open review infrastructure exists, while seed technical reviews do not establish a field-wide primary-study reproducibility audit.
verification_needed: Audit code/data/model/config/evaluation availability in representative primary-study strata.

gap_statement: Cognitive-load evidence is heterogeneous enough that a single claim that AR increases or decreases load is unsafe.
evidence_basis: 2026 meta-analysis reports I2=92.7%; 2025 systematic review reports ambiguous prior results and measurement limitations.
verification_needed: Expand beyond education/training and stratify by task, display, interaction, user characteristics, and measurement instrument.

gap_statement: Collaborative AR evidence remains context-fragmented, with interaction mechanisms and information representation requiring further controlled study.
evidence_basis: 2024 higher-education systematic review explicitly identifies these needs; older usability review found few natural-setting collaboration studies.
verification_needed: Check general AR-CSCW literature and heterogeneous-device collaboration before calling this persistent.

gap_statement: Accessibility is represented as an emerging frontier in broad wearable-AR synthesis while dedicated accessibility reviews remain narrower and evaluation-centered.
evidence_basis: 2023 TVCG wearable review flags accessibility as emerging; 2023 accessibility evaluation review focuses methods/metrics/tools.
verification_needed: Mine disability groups, tasks, devices, real-world validation, co-design and algorithmic accessibility.

gap_statement: Intelligent/LLM-based AR is rapidly emerging but long-term, privacy-aware and hardware-robust evidence appears immature.
evidence_basis: 2026 AR conversational-agent review finds 12/14 agent-based systems after 2023 and notes long-term engagement, privacy and hardware limitations.
verification_needed: Mine GenAI/LLM AR primary studies and compare evaluation horizons, privacy treatment and failure testing.
